texts.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

看到一个族群将家园安于星海之间而非任何星球之上，这种景象令人感到几分莫名的亲切。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]迫切希望能够进一步了解这些同为旅人的族群。
texts.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

There is something almost familiar about the sight of a people making their home among the stars rather than on any world. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is eager to learn more about these fellow travelers.

texts.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]星系中探测到的舰船似乎正在进行某种横跨星系的远征，这种生活方式对我们自己的族群而言并不陌生。他们没有表现出任何敌意，而是不断向我们方向重复广播信号。

一群流浪者，和我们没什么不一样，但却不太受人欢迎。[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]，[This.Leader.GetName]对此不太感兴趣，但也愿意听听他们要说什么。
texts.en:
The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system appear to be on some kind of expedition across the galaxy, a way of life our own people know well. They have made no hostile moves, broadcasting repetitive signals in our direction instead.

Wanderers, not unlike ourselves, though the comparison is an unwelcome one. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is unimpressed, but will hear what they have to say.

texts.zh: 在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中侦测到的舰队似乎是某种目的不明的跨星系探险队。他们没有采取任何有敌意的举动，也没有任何显而易见的重型武器，反而他们似乎在反复但无目的地向我们的大致方向广播某种具有实际内容的信号。我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]，[This.Leader.GetName]很困惑，但希望那些广播能帮助我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译他们的语言。
texts.en: The vessels detected in the [This.System.GetName] system seem to be part of some sort of expedition across the galaxy, with purposes unknown. They have not made any hostile moves, nor is there any heavy weaponry in evidence - instead, they seem to be broadcasting repetitive but not particularly content-filled signals in our general direction. Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy], [This.Leader.GetName], is confused, but hopes that the broadcasts will help our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translate their language.

texts.zh: [This.System.GetName]恒星系似乎是某种未知起源的先进社会的家园。居住在恒星系的一系列空间站中，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]留意到还有不少飞船在其间穿梭，同时还有一些目的不明的更大的远航舰队离开恒星系。他们似乎在向我们大致方向不断传播着重复的但没有实际内容的信号，这一进展令我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]感到困惑，但这有助于翻译他们的语言。
texts.en: The [This.System.GetName] system appears to be home to an advanced society of unknown origins. Dwelling in a series of space stations across the system, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] has observed multiple crafts flitting between them, as well as several larger expeditions leaving the system for unknown purposes. They seem to be broadcasting repetitive but not particularly content-filled signals in our general direction, a development which has confused our [This.Owner.GetLinguists], but may help them to translate their language.

label.zh: 蜂巢外的这些东西的行为确实很奇怪。
label.en: The actions of those outside the hive are indeed strange.

label.zh: 我们怎么才能彻底了解有机体。
label.en: How can we fathom the ways of organic life?

label.zh: 他们已经声明了自己在这片区域的航路吗？
label.en: Have they already claimed this region's Wayline routes?
